Scenario Description: Default 150 products list view with pagination & 10 exact columns
Action Taken: Loaded vendor dashboard /product with authenticated seller session
Expected Result: 150 products loaded, 10 items/page, 15 pages in pagination, all 10 columns present (Sl No, Name, ADS SKU, OEM SKU, Category, Variant count, Stock Status with pencil icon, Product Status, Image, Action buttons)
Actual Result: All 150 products rendered accurately without duplicate rows; Variant column shows variant count (3-5); Stock Status and Action buttons rendered

Action Taken: Clicked "CHARGER & CABLE" category tab button
Expected Result: Solid red active pill engaged on tab; Level 2 subcategories row dynamically revealed
Actual Result: Active red styling applied; Level 2 row appeared displaying HOME CHARGER, HOME ADAPTER, CABLES, etc.

Action Taken: Clicked "HOME ADAPTER" subcategory link
